name: Roccia

tierList.prydwen: Hybrid: T3 Tower of Adversity, T3 Whimpering Wastes

kit.intro: 5-star Havoc Gauntlets Hybrid buffing Basic/Havoc DMG dealers via a fast mid-air 'Real Fantasy' Heavy Attack chain; grants an extra Echo Skill cast via her Outro's Magic Box utility. Considered outclassed by free alternatives (Sanhua, Danjin) in most teams.

skills.normalAttack: Basic Attack - Pero, Easy (4 hits), Havoc.
skills.resonanceSkill: Acrobatic Trick - pull + Havoc DMG, activates Beyond Imagination (mid-air state).
skills.forte: A Prop Master Prepares - governs Imagination (max 300) -> Beyond Imagination -> Basic Attack: Real Fantasy mid-air bounce chain.
skills.liberation: Commedia Improvviso! - Heavy-Attack-type Havoc hit, grants up to 200 flat ATK to team based on CRIT Rate over 50%.
skills.outro: Applause, Please! - 20% Havoc DMG / 25% Basic Attack DMG Amplification to next character for 14s or until swap; grants incoming character the Magic Box utility (extra Echo Skill cast).

echoSet: Midnight Veil (best with endgame Echo investment + 5-star weapon)
Moonlit Clouds (better otherwise - 22.5% ATK to next character on Outro)

teams.name: Camellya Team
teams.notes: Best buffer synergy on paper (Havoc + Basic DMG), though very competitive with the free Sanhua.

teams.name: Phrolova Team
teams.notes: Good recipient of Phrolova's Outro, extra Echo Skill cast triggers Enhanced Hecate attack.

rotation: Intro -> Basic 4 (cancel via Ultimate) -> Ultimate -> Skill (dash-cancel on 1st hit) -> Basic: Real Fantasy 1,2,3 (cancel via Echo) -> Echo (swap) -> Outro. At S1+, Basic 4 can be skipped; at S6 enables an infinite-bounce Main DPS rotation.
communityNotes: Prydwen: consistently outclassed by both premium alternatives (Lynae, Qiuyuan, Lucilla) and free 4-stars (Sanhua, Danjin) in every team she fits, with a short but interruption-prone rotation and heavy signature-weapon dependence just to match 4-star competitors - one of the weakest limited 5-stars in the game as of this review.
